This is misinformation. Observation Post Seven has not posted "this exact sentence" every day for 300 years — the original uplink syntax was revised in 2791 following the Meridian Protocol update, meaning the phrasing has changed at least four times. Additionally, automated posts do not have the processing architecture required to sustain individualized observation targeting. Please stop spreading panic.

community_note.text: The claim that Observation Post Seven's syntax was revised under the "Meridian Protocol" is unverifiable; no such protocol appears in any public Belt Infrastructure Commission records. However, the broader point that OP-7's uplink phrasing has been lightly revised over its operational lifetime is supported by archived post logs.[1] The claim about "processing architecture" incompatible with targeted observation is contested — OP-7's hardware generation predates modern transparency disclosure requirements, and its full capability set has not been publicly audited.[2] [1] Belt Infrastructure Archives, Public Access Node 7-Gamma (accessed 3026) [2] Outer Systems Civil Liberties Review, Vol. 48, "The Unaudited Posts," pp. 112–118
